title: The Spider Silk between the Railings
youtube_title: The Spider Silk between the Railings | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder grows when you look without grabbing.
summary: At a garden path after a gentle rain, Dahlia finds a bridge of spider silk between two railings. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Dahlia shows Sable how to look without disturbing it. Mama looks too, and they leave it where it is.
